selected.evidence_basis: PubMed abstract (efetch PMID 41247792) and GEO series/sample records only; no full text
selected.assay: bulk RNA-seq, human skeletal muscle biopsies (NovaSeq X Plus; STAR + RSEM; edgeR v4.0.16 per GEO data_processing)
selected.subjects: n = 9 (7 M, 2 F), 24 +/- 1 yr; randomized crossover
selected.repeated_measure_unit: subject (each subject biopsied pre and post in both trials)
selected.primary_estimand: Within-subject effect of 60 min cycling at 65% VO2max on muscle gene expression (4 h post vs pre) in each trial, plus IN vs A at rest and the trial x exercise interaction
planned_contrasts: IN vs A at rest (Pre) (abstract: 9 DEGs)
trial x exercise interaction (abstract: GSEA only, no DEG count)
selected.paper_method: edgeR GLM (GEO data_processing: 'Differential expression estimation with edgeR v4.0.16'; supplementary file names 'edgeRglm_Counts_...')

paper_threshold.source_locator: abstract has no DEG threshold; full text not available

selected.inclusion: GEO holds 28 of 36 possible biopsies across 9 subjects (I02-I11, no I08): A-Pre 7, A-Post 7, IN-Pre 6, IN-Post 8

decisions.reason: Abstract: crossover design, biopsies before and 4 h after exercise in A and IN trials; DEG counts 9 (rest, IN vs A), 793 (A exercise), 1,403 (IN exercise). Threshold and exact model are not in the abstract. GEO data_processing names edgeR.

checks.metadata: GSE305038_metadata.csv built from the full GEO SOFT text (acc.cgi targ=all); Series_pubmed_id = 41247792; 28 samples, 9 subjects, trial x time labels match the abstract
checks.matrix: not obtainable: both deposited supplementary xlsx files (edgeRglm_Counts_*) returned HTTP 403 from ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/ (whole /geo/ tree blocked; 15-min retry loop failed); no per-sample files exist; NCBI-generated raw counts also 403

decisions.reason: Metadata belongs to the paper (pubmed id, design). The matrix file needed for every later gate could not be downloaded; the placeholder matrix_unavailable.txt records the attempts. This is a missing-file stop (manual_review), not a scientific refusal: the design (repeated-measures crossover with pre/post in two trials) does support the exercise contrast.

details.stop_reason: Expression matrix unavailable: GEO FTP (/geo/) returned HTTP 403 for both deposited supplementary files and the NCBI-generated counts; the matrix cannot be identified or checked against the paper's samples. Unblock by downloading GSE305038_20250714_M008795_edgeRglm_Counts_*.xlsx (or GSE305038_raw_counts_GRCh38.p13_NCBI.tsv.gz) into data/GSE305038 and rerunning.
